versions.document:
---
type: requirement
id: messages-reach-sessions
kind: behavior
text:
  - Envoy delivers each message to the session that it is for.

---
type: requirement
id: a-stored-message-survives-a-restart
kind: behavior
parent: messages-reach-sessions
text:
  - Envoy delivers each stored message to its session after the listener starts again.

---
type: check
id: a-production-restart-loses-no-message
serves: a-stored-message-survives-a-restart
subject: production
procedure: program
test:
  runner: go
  selector: github.com/sjawhar/envoy/cmd/listener TestAProductionRestartLosesNoMessage
  job: production-checks
claim: A message that production stores before a restart reaches its session after the restart.
procedure_text:
  - The program stores one message in production, starts the listener again and reads the messages of the session.
  - It must find the message one time.
failing_example:
  - A listener that deletes its stored messages when it starts.

---
type: check
id: the-graph-holds-a-delivery-of-each-message
serves: a-stored-message-survives-a-restart
subject: graph
procedure: query
claim: Each message record of the graph has a delivery record.
procedure_text:
  - The query reads each message record of the graph.
  - It returns each message record that has no delivery record.
failing_example:
  - A copy of the graph with one message record that has no delivery record.
